title: Milyan language
extract: Milyan, also known as Lycian B and previously Lycian 2, is an extinct ancient Anatolian language. It is attested from three inscriptions: two poems of 34 and 71 engraved lines, respectively, on the so-called Xanthian stele (or Xanthian Obelisk, found at Xanthos, and another, shorter, inscription on a sarcophagus at Antiphellus. All three poems are divided in strophes.
